description: Finds foods in the storage guide for a food word or a product name in Turkish, English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Russian, Japanese or Arabic (for example 'yoğurt', 'opened milk', 'Kaşar peyniri', 'Hähnchenbrust'). Returns up to 8 foods with their slug, a one-line summary and the page URL. Use the slug with get_storage_guide.

language.description: Language of the answer: tr, en, de, es, fr, it, ru, ja or ar. Defaults to the language the food was found in.

query.description: A food or product name, a few words at most.

name: search_foods
title: Search the storage guide
